name: Stepper
structurePatterns: horizontal: steps in a row connected by 2px lines; node 20px circles
completed node shows a white check; current shows a primary ring + inner dot; upcoming is an empty bordered circle
vertical: node on the left with a descending connector, label and supporting text to the right
error node uses danger border with an x/alert mark; state is not color-only
usageHints: horizontal preferred for 3-5 short steps; use vertical for long labels or many steps
do not shrink labels below the system hierarchy to force horizontal fit
stepper is for task progression, not event history (that is Timeline)
current step state must be exposed to accessibility
doNotInvent: no numbered badges by default (use check/dot)
no clickable future steps unless a product pattern explicitly allows it
